title: Flight search fan-out: cancellation that misses already-cancelled requests
name: Flight search cancellation

questions.prompt: Finance flagged that our flight suppliers billed us for about 30% more search requests than the searches users completed. Logs show that during the evening peak, when searches queue for a slot, the suppliers are still queried for searches whose users had already closed the tab, and each of those searches still holds a slot while the suppliers answer. Disconnects in the middle of a running search cancel correctly. Fix search/signals.ts so the tests pass.
